author: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>
subject: [PATCH] HID: uclogic: Correct devm device reference for hidinput input_dev name

findings.message: devm_kasprintf return value is not checked for allocation failure. The function returns ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM) on failure, which will be directly assigned to hi->input->name. Since error pointers are non-NULL, any subsequent code that checks if (hi->input->name) will treat it as a valid string, leading to crashes or memory corruption when it is dereferenced or passed to string functions.
